controls.title: Account Management
controls.required_state: Disable accounts when personnel transfer or contract ends; assign ownership for service accounts.
controls.current_state: Transfer and contractor offboarding gaps exist for USR011 and CTR001; SVC001 lacks an owner.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.required_state: Use just-in-time admin elevation and remove unnecessary standing privilege across clouds.
controls.current_state: Global administrators and privileged role admins still have permanent assignments; SVC001 remains overscoped.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.required_state: Use phishing-resistant MFA for privileged and mission-critical users.
controls.current_state: SMS MFA remains on privileged users; email OTP and no MFA remain for mission accounts and service accounts.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.required_state: Prevent credential sharing and ensure unique accountability for every authenticator.
controls.current_state: Credential sharing confirmed between USR017 and SVC001.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.required_state: Run recurring access reviews and cross-cloud telemetry correlation.
controls.current_state: Multiple access reviews are overdue and Azure/AWS admin visibility is siloed.

controls.title: Privileged Account Protections
controls.required_state: Protect administrators with strong MFA and least privilege in cloud SaaS and IaaS.
controls.current_state: Diana Reyes still uses SMS MFA and Sandra Okafor retains stale emergency access.

controls.title: Log and Review Administrative Actions
controls.required_state: Agencies should review admin account usage and retain evidence for review cycles.
controls.current_state: Audit evidence exists, but overdue reviews mean findings are not being remediated fast enough.
